description: MetaRalph Phase 7: Learning System - Cross-project pattern extraction, outcome tracking, proposal quality scoring.

userStories.title: Create learning model and repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to persist learnings so MetaRalph can improve over time.
acceptanceCriteria: src/learning/learning.ts exports Learning interface and LearningRepository
Learning: id, projectId, executionId, category, content, confidence, timesApplied, timesSuccessful, createdAt

userStories.title: Implement cross-project pattern extractor
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to extract patterns from successful executions to apply elsewhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Identifies: code patterns, gotchas, successful approaches
Assigns confidence based on frequency and success rate

userStories.title: Implement outcome tracker
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track execution outcomes to learn what works.
acceptanceCriteria: Correlates outcomes with: task type, project, source, approach
Updates learning confidence based on new outcomes

userStories.title: Implement proposal quality scoring
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track which proposals succeed to improve future proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: getQualityBySource() returns success rates by source (TODO, issue, strategic)
adjustConfidence(proposal) uses history to refine scores
Low-quality sources get deprioritized over time

userStories.title: Implement learning application
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to apply learnings to new tasks to improve success rates.
acceptanceCriteria: injectLearnings(task, learnings) adds context to PRD
Learnings included in CLAUDE.md prompt for Ralph
Tracks when learnings are applied and outcomes
